name: AMD Radeon gfx1201 16 GB class (RX 9070 XT, RX 9070)
memory_note: the 16 GB gfx1201 VRAM class (RX 9070 XT, RX 9070): loom-serve gets 15e9 bytes (16 GiB board - 2 GiB for the desktop session and driver). Measured on a Radeon RX 9070 XT; per-model values live in fleet/devices/gfx1201-16gb.json

card.title: Radeon gfx1201, 16 GB (RX 9070 XT, RX 9070)
card.serve_args_note: elastic backing; 4 MiB state slabs and 64 MiB weight slabs keep the 15 GB budget from being stranded in 64 MiB / 1 GiB commits
card.preload_note: preload: --parameter_mode=preload (stock-host fix for ROCm/hrx-system#3332) on every package that fits the GPU (a stock Ubuntu host's 8 MiB memlock makes the default file mode fail at the first request): null = no weight limit, the host copy lives in system RAM, not in the 16 GB

gfx1201-16gb.name: AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (gfx1201, 16 GB)
gfx1201-16gb.note: SPEC, not measured: GDDR6 20 Gbps, 256-bit = 640 GB/s peak; 64 CUs x 1024 x 2.97 GHz = 195 TFLOP/s dense f16 WMMA (AMD's spec). A measured bandwidth would replace the peak

runner.note: no DevLab runner: results come from a named machine (fleet/devices/gfx1201-16gb.json, provenance per session)
